annotations.title: Mark a GitHub pull request ready, or back to draft

description: Mark a draft pull request ready for review, or with undo true turn it back into a draft. Marking it ready notifies the people asked to review it. A pull request that is in the asked state already is left as it is: nothing is sent and changed is false. Only an open pull request can change; a closed or merged one is an error. A pull request is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL; a bare number means the working tree's repository, or repo.

pr.description: The pull request, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

undo.description: Turn the pull request back into a draft instead of marking it ready.

name: github_pr_ready

changed.description: False when the pull request was in the asked state already and nothing was sent.

draft.description: Whether the pull request is a draft now.

title: Mark a GitHub pull request ready, or back to draft
